audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart disagreed with the content layer (which matches the packet) on all seven rows.
audit.why: Even 1-2, Zed's shadow-Q poke wins 3-5, Malzahar's 6 hard-counters Death Mark, first lethality item swings back to Zed, Zhonya's and 2+ items settle it for Malzahar (54.46% WR, 5239 games).
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content win[]; every why rewritten to match its verdict.

audit.why: Spikes: Zed's 3-5 poke window, Malzahar's level 6 counter (point-click suppress on a diver who must appear in range), Zed's first-item burst window, Malzahar's Zhonya's spike late. spikes[0..3] state all four with the counterplay.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit; two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: The decisive interaction: Death Mark (120/110/100s) forces Zed into 700 range of a point-click suppress; Malzahar's passive additionally grants damage reduction and CC immunity, so the correct order is eat the engage on shield, then R him for the mark's 3-second duration. Living Shadow is 20s rank 1 — his poke and escape both die with it.
audit.corrected: Numbers added, bleed bullets replaced with Death Mark-specific sequencing.

edits.before: E a caster minion and let the visions farm for you — your lane is a macro pattern, not a duel, from the first wave.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — neither has a kill threat yet; take safe farm and don't eat free Razor Shurikens through the wave.

edits.before: Q online: the silence is your trade answer. Use it on his engage spell, not on poke he can walk around.
edits.after: Still even at 2 — his shadow combo isn't online, so both of you just farm; keep the wave near the middle.

edits.before: W voidlings turn your shove permanent — the wave hits his tower while you ward, roam-shadow, or just exist safely.
edits.after: Level 3 is his: double-Q shadow poke with energy refunds wins the harass war — shield the Q or give up the trade.

edits.before: Lost Chapter and the machine is complete: E-hops fund themselves, the wave is always crashing, and his tower is always bleeding.
edits.after: Through 4-5 his poke and roam threat keep him ahead — you lack the ult answer, so shove with E and track where his W lands.

edits.before: Nether Grasp online — with ANY jungle presence you now have a guaranteed kill button. The lane bends around your 6.
edits.after: Nether Grasp hard-counters Death Mark: he must appear next to you, and a point-click suppress ends the dive he started.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: visions melt waves AND health bars. Suppress-into-burn kills through most defensive answers.
edits.after: First lethality item lets his burst outrace your suppress when your passive is down — step up only with shield AND R.

edits.before: Late Malz is a number: one suppression on their carry equals one won teamfight. Shield up, flank smart, press R.
edits.after: Post-Zhonya you counter the engage: bait Death Mark, survive the pop, and suppress him as it expires — you win late.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. It governs your forward steps. - spell shield (Iron Boundary) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Zed Death Mark: 120/110/100s — the all-in; spend your shield or Zhonya AFTER the mark lands, then suppress him as it pops. - Living Shadow is 20s at rank 1 — with W down he cannot poke-double or escape a gank. - Your R is 140/110/80: hold it for his dive, nothing else.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Call of the Void's silence during Death Mark's dash window stops the follow-up combo — Q the spot he appears and he stands in your zone with no buttons.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: With passive down and Nether Grasp spent you have no answer to a 625-range untargetable dive — that plate costs more than it pays.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport standard — TP doubles your shove-tax map game. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport standard — TP turns each wave crash into a cross-map play. Ghost-Cleanse exists into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.

edits.before: Zed wins by landing Death Mark, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Zed wins by diving with Death Mark while your shield and R are down — the mark pops before your DoT damage adds up.
